text:
Ava (CS): Morning — quick sync thread. I sketched a compact handoff sprint (customer-facing) we can use for small pilots. Goal: safe go-live, capture signals for renewal risk, and keep costs bounded. Pinged Jamal & Priya for ops + telemetry.

Jamal (AE): Nice — can you share the one-pager checklist so I can send it to the AE? :thumbsup:

Ava (CS): Yep — minimal checklist below (send to customer after kickoff):
- prefill ~50 mixed queries (short/long) across top intents
- stagger prefill over 30–90m (avoid spike)
- enable prefix caching for session flows
- client-side streaming for interactive experiences
- set target batch_size=8 for dedicated pools (or default for hosted)
- monitor first-6h warm pool + scale down to baseline after 24h

Priya (Telemetry): For onboarding dashboard, add these widgets: avg cold latency, prefix cache hit %, streaming error rate (per 100k tokens), 7d active users, 14d retention %. Also add a simple qualitative capture: "Why did you reduce usage?" -> link to short survey.

Eli (SRE): Ops notes: use warm-pool for boot phase. Add jitter to prefill to smooth scheduling. If you need a quick warmup endpoint, run: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-co","samples":50,"jitter_ms":30000}'
```
Also watch for OOMs when batch_size>12 on smaller GPUs.

Ava (CS): Renewal signal heuristics (for AE): flag tenant if any of the following after 14 days: usage < 20% of expected, prefix cache hit < 50%, repeated stream failures > 0.5% of requests. When flagged, AE to run a 15-min tech check call + send short survey.

Jamal (AE): Got it. We'll include a 2-step cadence: 3d check-in (ops health), 14d adoption review (renewal flags). I'll prepare the email template.

Priya (Telemetry): I'll add alerts: prefix cache hit < 60% (warning), <50% (sev), streaming errors >0.2% => page. Also create an onboarding cohort in analytics to track lift.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled warm-pool job for tenant acme-co will start in 10 minutes.

Jamal (AE): Copy that. We'll watch the first hour and be ready to jig the prefill window if needed.

Ava (CS): I drafted the one-pager and a Notion handoff template: https://redwood.in/notion/handoff-sprint-heartbeat — feedback welcome by EOD.

Priya (Telemetry): Reviewed and left 2 small wording suggestions (added to Notion).

Eli (SRE): Thumbs up from infra. Recommend adding a tiny circuit-breaker: if failed streams >1% for 5m, fallback to non-streaming responses for that tenant.

Ava (CS): Good call — added fallback policy to the template. Thanks team — closing this sync. :tada:
